notes: VELSTRIA の UI 装飾アートの仕様（差し込み口）。コードは PortraitArt.frame(name) で Assets.xcassets/UIFrames/<id>、PortraitArt.spell(id) で Assets.xcassets/SpellIcons/<id> を読む。アートが無い間はコードの手続き描画にフォールバックするので、ここに挙げた画像を後から入れるだけで見た目が差し替わる。生成は portraits.py と同じ要領（Codex CLI の画像生成）で行い、採用版を各フォルダへ JPEG/PNG で入れる。半透明が要る枠・幕は PNG（アルファ付き）、地色・アイコンは JPEG で可。導入後は該当 imageset の Contents.json も用意すること（item アイコンと同じ構造）。

ui_frames.style: Premium fantasy mobile MOBA (Arena of Valor / Honor of Kings / Mobile Legends 系) の UI 装飾。手描きの金細工・宝石・魔法発光。読みやすさ優先で中央は空ける。文字・数字・ロゴ・透かしは一切入れない。

assets.use: スコアボード全面の地色（奥に薄く敷く。中央は暗めで情報が乗る）。横長 16:9 程度。
assets.prompt: A dark, atmospheric full-screen background for a fantasy MOBA post-battle scoreboard, horizontal 16:9. A deep cosmic battlefield at night: near-black navy and deep indigo toward the center so overlaid text stays readable, with a faint cool-blue glow bleeding in from the left edge and a faint warm crimson-orange glow from the right edge (team colors), drifting embers and a few faint stars, soft volumetric light, painterly AAA splash-art quality. Very low detail and low contrast in the central 70% so UI reads on top. No characters, no text, no numbers, no logos, no UI elements, no frame.

assets.use: スコアボードの外枠（9-slice で伸縮。capInsets 48pt）。中央は完全透明。
assets.prompt: An ornate gilded fantasy UI border frame for a MOBA scoreboard, intended as a 9-slice stretchable PNG with a fully transparent center. Hand-painted polished gold and dark-bronze filigree with small blue and crimson gemstone accents at the corners, a subtle inner bevel and soft rim light, slightly thicker ornate corners and thin straight edges. Transparent background and transparent center hole. No text, no numbers, no characters, no scenery.

assets.use: （任意）青チーム列の見出し幕。未使用でも可。
assets.prompt: A sapphire-blue heraldic banner header strip for a fantasy MOBA team panel, 9-slice stretchable PNG, transparent background. Painted deep blue cloth with gold trim, a subtle shield emblem motif on the left, soft cyan glow. No text, no numbers, no logos.

assets.use: （任意）赤チーム列の見出し幕。未使用でも可。
assets.prompt: A crimson heraldic banner header strip for a fantasy MOBA team panel, 9-slice stretchable PNG, transparent background. Painted deep red cloth with gold trim, a subtle flame emblem motif on the right, soft ember glow. No text, no numbers, no logos.

assets.use: （任意）中央の VS 紋章。未使用でも可（コードは文字 VS を描く）。
assets.prompt: A small ornate 'versus' crest emblem for a fantasy MOBA, centered on a transparent background: two crossed swords over a gold laurel medallion split blue-left / crimson-right, polished metal, soft glow. No text, no letters, no numbers.

spell_icons.style: Round 1:1 battle-spell icon for VELSTRIA, a premium fantasy mobile MOBA. Hand-painted semi-realistic icon, one clear magical motif centered on a dark radial background tinted by the spell color, dramatic rim light and strong value contrast so the silhouette reads at 36 pixels. Full-bleed square (the app clips it to a circle and draws its own gold ring on top). No text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no border, no frame.

assets.name: Flicker
assets.prompt: a short golden teleport blink: a burst of amber-gold arcane sparks and a faint directional streak, two overlapping ghost silhouettes of light suggesting an instant short-range jump.

assets.name: Purify
assets.prompt: a cleansing cyan burst that breaks chains: a radiant teal-cyan starburst shattering dark shackles into motes, a clean protective shimmer.

assets.name: Heal
assets.prompt: a warm restorative heal: a glowing green heart or cross of soft light with gentle radiant petals and rising sparkles.

assets.name: Barrier
assets.prompt: a protective shield bubble: a translucent sky-blue hexagonal energy barrier with a bright rim and soft inner glow.

assets.name: Smite
assets.prompt: a jungle smite strike: a fierce lime-green beast claw mark or fang slashing with sparks, wild and primal.

assets.name: Sprint
assets.prompt: a haste surge: swift teal-aqua wind streaks and a running speed glyph, motion-blurred forward dashes.

assets.name: Flameburst
assets.prompt: a burning ignite: a fierce red-orange flame burst with embers and a scorch mark, aggressive heat glow.

assets.name: Vanish

assets.name: Teleport
assets.prompt: a long-range teleport gate: an indigo-blue arcane portal ring with swirling energy and a doorway of light.

assets.name: Weaken
